alert.name: ECSServiceAlarm
alert.summary: CloudWatch alarm fired for ECS service checkout

tool_errors: logs: logs: /ecs/checkout: An error occurred (ResourceNotFoundException) when calling the FilterLogEvents operation: The specified log group does not exist.

root_cause.hypothesis: Task count healthy (2/2 running, 0 pending, no failed deploys) - not a scaling/deploy failure. CPU near-zero (~0.005%) is odd signal: either service genuinely idle (traffic not reaching it - possible upstream LB/target-group/DNS issue) or alarm tied to low-CPU threshold, not crash/OOM. Memory normal (58.6%). No logs/deploy history provided to confirm cause.
evidence: tasks_running == tasks_desired (2.0/2.0), tasks_pending 0 -> service not failing to place tasks
deployments_failed 0.0, deployments_in_flight 1.0 -> deploy ongoing, not stuck/rolled back
cpu_utilization_pct near zero (~0.0048%) -> unusually low, suggests no traffic/work reaching tasks rather than resource exhaustion

proposal.reasoning: Tasks 2/2 healthy, 0 pending, no failed deploys, mem normal 58.6%. CPU ~0% not crash/OOM signal - looks like idle/no-traffic (LB/target-group/DNS routing issue upstream) or alarm threshold too low. No logs or deploy history to confirm root cause. Automated action (restart/scale/rollback) unjustified without traffic/routing evidence - could mask real upstream issue or do nothing.
proposal.expected_effect: Human investigates LB/target-group health checks, DNS, and traffic routing to confirm whether checkout genuinely idle or alarm miscalibrated; no blind remediation risk taken.

reasons: Action is inert or advisory; no approval required.
